newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African golds tumble, but industrials at peaks.
newsitem.headline: S.African golds tumble, but industrials at peaks.

text.p: Bullion's slide to its weakest level in over four years winded South African gold shares, tearing three percent off the index at the close and wounding marginal mines specialist Randgold.

But industrial stocks turned a blind eye to the gold board's woes surging to new peaks as share prices were inflated by Monday's quarter close-out for many unit trusts and heavy early morning futures arbitrage dealings.

Dealers and analysts said that in addition to bullion's fall to $334, gold shares were further pressured by bleak prospects for the South African industry's second quarter results which were expected to show a loss for the first time ever.

The all gold index fell 29.8 points to 965.0, its lowest level since March 1993. The industrial index finished at a fresh closing high of 8,790.5, a gain of 42.9 points and lifting the all-share index nine points to 7,420.0.

Views were mixed on market direction for Tuesday with some dealers worried about possible further weakness in the rand which touched five-month lows ahead of the easing of foreign exchange controls on private individuals on Tuesday.
But others were upbeat on the positive outlook for an interest rate cut.
